provenance.title: CDK2 · N2 analog exploration

protocol.name: guided-local-v1
protocol.chemical_scaffold: Exact 18-heavy-atom parent graph retained; grow only at supplied N2 attachment
protocol.initial_pose: Parent 1H1P full18 coordinates guide initial embedding; this is a prior, not frozen during refinement
protocol.refinement: Vina 1.2.7 local_only; ligand translation, orientation and torsions released; receptor rigid
protocol.property_profile_interpretation: A declared design profile, not universal drug-likeness
protocol.review_ready: PoseBusters pass, purine ring drift <=2 A, and at least one detected Glu81/Leu83 hydrogen-bond type
protocol.review_ready_interpretation: Within this design hypothesis; not evidence of experimental binding
protocol.pose_selection: Among review-ready poses prefer Asp86 contact if present, then lowest Vina score; otherwise lowest score review-ready pose; if none, lowest score pose shown with failure labels
protocol.objective: Explore N2 analogs that can make an Asp86 polar contact while preserving a plausible hinge-local binding pose and bounded molecular properties
protocol.score_usage: Within a fixed preparation/protocol, review evidence and model tradeoffs; no automatic potency claim
protocol.receptor_preparation: 1H1P A/B heterodimer, TPO160 retained, waters removed, neutral9H ligand core
protocol.calibration: Chosen after known CDK2 controls; same settings frozen before evaluating seed43 batch

limitations: Synthetic molecular proposals with actual local pose computations; not synthesized compounds
Scores are Vina model scores, not measured binding affinity
Hydrogen bonds depend on ligand/protein preparation and distance/angle criteria
Rigid receptor, water removal, one ligand tautomer and small pose budget are approximations
Unspecified proposal stereochemistry can become one stereochemical realization in3D; isomer enumeration was not validated
Protocol chosen on four known CDK2 structures; not a held-out generalization benchmark
